name: @etzhayyim/shigotoba-kotoba
description: kotoba reference implementation of shigotoba (仕事場 business-establishment registry + job-board open-data: company profiles + job postings, ILO/national registries) using @etzhayyim/sdk. Registry on AT PDS (replaces RW graph). Employer-side public data only (no job-seeker PII); summarize LLM proxy stays etzhayyim. Substrate posture per ADR-2605172000.
